text:
rico: Huge thanks to @nina (people-ops) and @omar (eng) for coordinating the surprise cake + sticker swap after the demo. saved morale and also my keyboard (it needed frosting therapy). :cake: :sparkles:
nina: team effort! shoutout to @kelly in office ops who tracked down the cake delivery when the courier went rogue. cake is in the kitchenette, label: "kudos-cake". please slice responsibly. :knife_fork_plate: :tada:
omar: also big props to @pat who ran a last-minute laptop handoff so the demo could continue. grabbed the spare HDMI and MacBook like a pro. :muscle: :laptop:
recruiter-bot: hire_notify: Lev offered to buy lunch for the folks who helped on the candidate setup. reminder: kudos are real currency. :bell:
kelly: courier had the wrong conference room on the ticket. found the driver at reception and shepherded them to the right door. tiny victory. :walking: :package:
pat: happy to help. also took the last red "Launch" sticker for my water bottle. leaving a tiny sticker ferris wheel on the whiteboard. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye: :label:
lev: thanks for the shoutout. will take you up on lunch, @rico. also, whoever ate the strawberry slice (no judgement) leave a reaction so we know who to bribe next time. :strawberry: :laughing:
kudos-bot: badge_awarded: "cross-team-hero" to nina, omar, kelly, pat at 11:03. :medal:
rico: leaving this here so the folks who jumped in get recognized in the all-hands. drop a quick emoji if you took cake or a sticker so we can keep an eye on supplies. extra hugs for the courier who didn't bail. :heart:
pat: cake status: 3 slices left. grabbing coffee to go with it. :coffee: :cake:
omar: quick note: added a small doc in #office-ops with courier best-practices so next time we don't play hide-and-seek. :memo:
nina: tiny follow-up: sending a thank-you note to the facilities team and tagging this thread in the kudos doc. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
